raw_response: {"diagnosis": "raw_customers is an SCD2 dimension: 230 rows for 200 customers, with 30 historical rows where is_current=False. silver_customers keeps every version, so the region join fans out and gold_region_daily overcounts (5353 vs 4630); the fix is to keep only the current version per customer, which is valid from 2025-01-01 and so covers every transaction date.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.9, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_customers": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT customer_id, upper(region) AS region FROM raw_customers QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY is_current DESC, valid_from DESC) = 1"}}
